title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1988-07-15
lineage: Beta HiFi Master (Sony SL-HF66) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >dBpoweramp > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24
source: Pre-FM (KPFA Air-Check) > Beta HiFi Master (Sony ES-HG)

ai_review.summary: Clear but a bit thin recording; the show is uneven with some smoking moments and other bland/sloppy sections.
ai_review.review: The tape offers decent clarity though it lacks a little warmth, making it an acceptable listening source. Performance-wise the concert swings between high‑energy stretches and sections that feel bland or sloppy, leaving the overall impression mixed. No specific songs or player highlights are called out in the review.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; reviewer praises clarity but notes lack of warmth and uneven playing, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear sound with good definition, but described as short on warmth and slightly thin.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Performance is inconsistent – some sections are described as 'smokin' while others are bland or sloppy.
